metric_definitions.ndcg@10: Graded gains 2^grade - 1 with log2(rank + 1) discounts, cutoff 10.
metric_definitions.precision@5: Relevant papers in the first five positions, divided by five.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant paper, over the full ranked list.
metric_definitions.ap@10: Sum of precision@rank at relevant hits in ranks 1–10, divided by min(10, total relevant judgments); zero if no relevant judgments.
metric_definitions.map@10: Unweighted mean of per-query AP@10 within each source group.
metric_definitions.pairwise_accuracy: All scored, explicitly judged unordered pairs with unequal grades: 1 for a higher score on the higher grade, 0 for reversal, 0.5 for an exact score tie. Equal-grade pairs are excluded. No comparable pairs yields null. Source-group means omit null queries and report the valid query count.

protocol: Rank each query's explicitly judged pool by title+abstract cosine; all three methods use identical verified candidates, including synthetic batches. No title-priority rule or live topic retrieval. nDCG uses grades 0–3. Precision@5, MRR and AP@10 use grade >=2. MAP@10 averages AP@10 with denominator min(10, total relevant judgments). Pairwise accuracy uses all unequal-grade judged pairs and gives half credit for exact score ties; undefined queries are excluded from its mean and counted separately. Macro averages weight queries equally. Human and synthetic results are separate. Training overlap is reported, not filtered. Synthetic-label agreement is not human ground truth; two human queries limit inference. No training or model updates are performed. The 45 new training batches are unused.
